example.hanzi: 警察在现场找到了子弹。
example.pinyin: jǐngchá zài xiànchǎng zhǎodào le zǐdàn
example.english: Police found a bullet at the scene.

example.hanzi: 请你仔细看看这份合同。
example.pinyin: qǐng nǐ zǐxì kàn kan zhè fèn hétong
example.english: Please read this contract over carefully.

example.hanzi: 她今天穿了一件紫色的裙子。
example.pinyin: tā jīntiān chuān le yí jiàn zǐ sè de qúnzi
example.english: She is wearing a purple skirt today.

example.hanzi: 父母为他的成绩感到自豪。
example.pinyin: fùmǔ wèi tā de chéngjì gǎndào zìháo
example.english: His parents are proud of what he has achieved.

example.hanzi: 警方排除了自杀的可能。
example.pinyin: jǐng fāng pái chúle zìshā de kěnéng
example.english: The police have ruled out suicide.

example.hanzi: 这些工作都是他自愿做的。
example.pinyin: zhèxiē gōngzuò dōu shì tā zìyuàn zuò de
example.english: He took on all this work of his own accord.

example.hanzi: 公司总裁明天将回答记者的问题。
example.pinyin: gōngsī zǒngcái míngtiān jiāng huídá jìzhě de wèntí
example.english: The company chairman will take questions from reporters tomorrow.

example.hanzi: 参加考试的总数超过了三千人。
example.pinyin: cānjiā kǎoshì de zǒngshù chāoguò le sān qiān rén
example.english: The total number sitting the exam passed three thousand.

example.hanzi: 等了两个小时，车总算来了。
example.pinyin: děng le liǎng ge xiǎoshí chē zǒngsuàn lái le
example.english: After a two-hour wait, the bus finally came.

example.hanzi: 总体来看，今年的情况不错。
example.pinyin: zǒngtǐ lái kàn jīnnián de qíngkuàng búcuò
example.english: Overall, this year's picture is a good one.

example.hanzi: 交通问题阻碍了当地的发展。
example.pinyin: jiāotōng wèntí zǔ'ài le dāngdì de fāzhǎn
example.english: Transport problems have held back the area's development.

example.hanzi: 公司组织了一次员工培训。
example.pinyin: gōngsī zǔzhī le yí cì yuángōng péixùn
example.english: The company ran a training session for its staff.

example.hanzi: 他昨晚喝醉了，什么也不记得。
example.pinyin: tā zuó wǎn hē zuì le shénme yě bú jìde
example.english: He got drunk last night and remembers nothing.

example.hanzi: 他是一位很受学生尊敬的老教授。
example.pinyin: tā shì yí wèi hěn shòu xuésheng zūnjìng de lǎo jiàoshòu
example.english: He is an old professor his students look up to.

example.hanzi: 我们应该尊重别人的选择。
example.pinyin: wǒmen yīnggāi zūnzhòng biéren de xuǎnzé
example.english: We should respect other people's choices.

example.hanzi: 每个人都要遵守这里的规定。
example.pinyin: měi ge rén dōu yào zūnshǒu zhèlǐ de guīdìng
example.english: Everyone has to abide by the rules here.
